public.hero.title: Sigaba sesilimo sibalwa ngesimo selitulu lesentekile
public.hero.intro: Mecropolis ihlanganisa emayunithi ekushisa ekukhula kusukela kuhlanyelwe, isebentisa emazinga ekushisa lagcinwe yi-Open-Meteo. Isikhatsi sekulima ngasinye eNshonalanga Kapa sidlulela esigabeni lesilandzelako uma samba sekwendlula umkhawulo wesilimo.

public.how.title: Kusukela elangeni lekuhlanyela kuya esigabeni
public.how.lead: Sigaba sivame kufakwa ngesandla, ngako silandzela kubuyeketa kwekugcina kuphela. Lapha sibalwa ngesimo selitulu lesigciniwe, futsi lonkhe lushintjo lugcina bufakazi balo.
public.step.1.title: Gcina loko umlimi lakwatiko
public.step.1.body: Emapulazi, emasimu, tilimo nemalanga ekuhlanyela kugcinwa ku-Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Letsa simo selitulu lesentekile
public.step.2.body: Emazinga ekushisa elanga nelanga endzaweni yelinsimu avela emlandvweni we-Open-Meteo, kusukela ekuhlanyeleni kuze kube ngulamuhla.
public.step.3.title: Hlanganisa emayunithi ekushisa
public.step.3.body: Emayunithi ekushisa ekukhula (GDD) ahlanganiswa ngekwemodeli yesilimo. Uma kweciwa umkhawulo, luhlelo ludlulisela sikhatsi sekulima esigabeni lesilandzelako bese lugcina sizatfu.
public.models.title: Emamodeli etilimo lasetjentiswako
public.models.lead: Emayunithi ekushisa ladzingekako kuze silimo sivutfwe ngekushisa. Letinombolo tibhalwe ngesandla futsi atikabi nayo imitfombo.
public.live.title: Simo epulazini lekukhombisa laseSwartland
public.live.lead: Tilinganiso tivela emithonjeni yesive, tibuyeketwa njalo ngemizuzu lengu-30.
public.yields.title: Tilinganiso tesivuno letishicilelwe
public.honesty.title: Indlela imininingwane lephatfwa ngayo
public.honesty.1.title: Sivuno sifakwa ngumsebentisi
public.honesty.1.body: Luhlelo lukhombisa “Akukabhalwa” kuze umsebenti abhale sivuno.
public.honesty.2.title: Tilinganiso tigcinwa todvwa
public.honesty.2.body: Tibalo tesifundza netelive tigcinwa emibhalweni yato, kanye nemtfombo neyunithi. Aticatsaniswa nesivuno sensimu.
public.honesty.3.title: Imininingwane yetilokatane yesifundza
public.honesty.3.body: Imininingwane ye-GBIF ikhombisa lapho tilokatane tabonwa khona ekhatsi kwa-100 km, kanye nelibanga.
public.honesty.4.title: Simo selitulu sibuyeketa ngaleso sikhatsi
public.honesty.4.body: Emazinga ekushisa atsatfwa emlandvweni we-Open-Meteo nawacelwa.
public.open.title: Vula sikhatsi sekulima
public.open.body: Ngena kudeshibhodi yesibonelo ubone lijika le-GDD lesikhatsi sekulima nebufakazi besigaba saso.
public.live.unavailable: Imininingwane ye-{source} ayitfolakali nyalo ({reason}). Kute lokukhonjiswa esikhundleni sayo.
public.live.weatherChart: Kushisa lokuphansi nalokuphakeme kanye nemvula yelilanga ngalinye esikhatsini sesibikezelo
public.live.pestsLead: Imininingwane lenendzawo ekhatsi kwa-{radius} km kusuka epulazini.
public.yield.lead: Letinhlobo letintsatfu tikala tintfo letehlukene ngetilinganiso letehlukene, ngako aticatsaniswa todvwa noma nanobe nguyiphi insimu.
public.about.title: Mayelana
public.about.heading: Mayelana ne-Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis luhlelo lwekulandzelela emasimu netilimo epulazini laseWestern Cape.
public.about.why.title: Kungani lukhona
public.about.why.body: Imininingwane yesigaba iyaguga, kantsi sivuno sivame kubhalwa ngekukhumbula. Mecropolis ibala sigaba ngesimo selitulu lesibhaliwe. Yonke inombolo ivela kumsebenti noma emtfombweni wemphakatsi lobhalwe ngelibito.
public.about.design.title: Indlela lolwakhiwe ngayo
public.about.design.1.body: Emayunithi ekushisa (GDD) acala kubutsana ngelilanga lekuhlanyela, kusetjentiswa umlando we-Open-Meteo. Kuntjintja ngakunye kwesigaba kugcina bufakazi: lilanga lokucale ngalo, samba se-GDD naloko lesibalwe ngako.
public.about.design.2.body: Sigaba lesilandzela sangaphambi kwekuvuna sibitwa ngekuvutfwa ngekushisa ngoba kute kuvuna lokubhaliwe.
public.about.design.4.body: Tigcinwa emibhalweni yato kanye nemtfombo, iyunithi nelayisensi.
public.about.stack.title: Bucwepheshe
public.about.stack.body: Luhlelo lwelikhasi linye lwe-Vite ne-React 19 ku-Cloudflare Pages. Siphequluli sifundza imininingwane yemphakatsi ye-Sanity ngco nge-GROQ nangekulalela lokwentiwa ngaleso sikhatsi. Lokubhalwako nemininingwane lenekhiye kudlula ku-Cloudflare Pages Functions, lokuhlola ikhukhi yeseshini lesayiniwe. Zod ihlola lapho imininingwane ingena khona, Vitest yenta luhlolo, kantsi Tailwind 4 yenta kubukeka.
public.about.limits.title: Lokulinganiselwe lokwatiwako
public.about.limits.1: Tinombolo temodeli yesilimo (kushisa lokusisekelo, emayunithi ekushisa kuze kuhlume nekuvutfwa) tibhalwe ngesandla futsi atikabi nayo imitfombo.
public.about.limits.2: Silinganiso se-lupin sivela ku-HarvestStat seminyaka ya-2000 kuya ku-2007 kuphela, futsi kucalisa imininingwane akuzange kutfole imibhalo yesilinganiso se-lupin.
public.about.limits.3: Imininingwane yetilokatane yimibhalo ye-GBIF yetindzawo letisedvute nelipulazi. Ikhombisa lapho luhlobo lwabhalwa khona edvute nelipulazi.
public.about.limits.4: Sibonelo sinendlela yinye yekungena lesetjentiswa ngibo bonkhe nesivimbeli seticelo lesigcinwe enkumbulweni. Kungena kufihla emakhasi edeshibhodi kodvwa akuvikeli imininingwane: wonkhe umuntfu angayifundza. Kodvwa kuvikela konkhe lokubhalwako.

docs.stages.title: Kuhamba kwetigaba
docs.stages.intro: Tikhatsi tekulima tihamba embili ngetigaba letisitfupha:
docs.stages.guards: Kusuka esigabeni kuya kulesinye kunemibandzela. Lesihlanyelwe sidzinga lilanga lekuhlanyela nesilimo; lesikhulako sidzinga umkhawulo wekuhluma ngemayunithi ekushisa; sangaphambi kwekuvuna sidzinga 90% wemkhawulo wekuvutfwa; kuvutfwa ngekushisa kudzinga kufinyelela emkhawulweni wekuvutfwa; kubuyeketa kudzinga sifinyeto sesimo selitulu sesikhatsi sekulima nesilinganiso lesitfolakele. Imibandzela ye-GDD iphindze idzinge imininingwane yekushisa lokungenani ku-90% wesikhatsi, futsi kuya esigabeni lesinelilanga lelisengakafiki kuyavinjwa.

docs.seed.title: Kufaka imininingwane yekucala
docs.seed.body: {0} kufaka lipulazi lesibonelo, emasimu, tilimo netikhatsi tekulima kudathasethi lehleliwe, bese kuvumelanisa tilinganiso tesifundza. Kutsatsa indzawo yelipulazi, emasimu netilimo, ngako kwente kuphela kudathasethi yakho.
guide.title: Isetjentiswa njani iMecropolis
guide.lead: Umhlahlandlela lomfisha ngemavi lalula. Ukutjela kutsi le-app yentani, yabani nekutsi incenye ngayinye yentani.
guide.what.title: Iyini iMecropolis
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis yi-app yekulandzelela emasimu netilimo. Ibala kutsi silimo sesikhule kangakanani ngekuhlanganisa kufutfumala lesikutfola kusukela sihlanyelwe. Iphindze ikukhombise simo selitulu, umhlabatsi netilokatane letisedvute nelipulazi lakho endzaweni yinye.
guide.what.p2: Yentelwa emapulazi aseNshonalanga Kapa eNingizimu Afrika, kodvwa ingasebenta kunoma nguliphi lipulazi, sifundza noma sikhatsi sekulima.
guide.who.title: Yabani
guide.who.p1: Yemuntfu lonakekela emasimu, njengemlimi, umphatsi welipulazi noma umeluleki wabo.
guide.who.p2: Awudzingi kwati ngemakhompyutha noma ngesayensi yesimo selitulu. Nawukhona kuvula iwebhusayithi, ungayisebentisa iMecropolis.
guide.why.title: Kungani ungayisebentisa
guide.why.1: Ungabona masinyane kutsi ngutiphi tilimo letisandza kuhlanyelwa, letikhulako naletiseceleni kwekuvutfwa.
guide.why.2: Awudzingi kulungisa insimu ngayinye ngesandla, ngoba le-app itichubela silimo esigabeni lesilandzelako uma simo selitulu sikhombisa kutsi sesikhatsi.
guide.why.3: Ikucwayisa ngesitfwatfwa nekushisa lokukhulu kwemalanga lambalwa latako, nangetilokatane letibonwe edvute nelipulazi lakho.
guide.why.4: Konkhe lokubhalwe ngensimu, njengemutsi lofafatiwe, silokatane losibonile noma liphuzu, kugcinwa endzaweni yinye nelusuku lwako kuze ukubuke emuva.
guide.why.5: Inombolo ngayinye ikhombisa lapho ivela khona, kuze wati longakwetsemba.
guide.heat.title: I-app yati njani kutsi silimo sesikuphi
guide.heat.p1: Titjalo tikhula masinyane nakufutfumele, tikhule kancane nakumakhata. Mecropolis ibala lokufutfumala onkhe emalanga njengemayunithi ekushisa, bososayensi labawabita ngekutsi growing degree days noma GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Lilanga ngalinye itsatsa silinganiso lesisemkhatsini welizinga lekushisa lelisetulu naleliphansi, bese isusa lizinga lapho silimo siyekela khona kukhula. Lokusele ngemayunithi ekushisa alelo langa. Lilanga lelibandzako alengeti lutfo.
guide.heat.p3: Silimo ngasinye sidzinga linani lelitsite lemayunithi ekushisa ngaphambi kwekutsi sivutfwe. Njengobe linani kusukela ekuhlanyelweni lisondzela kulelo nani, silimo siya esigabeni lesilandzelako.
guide.heat.p4: Emazinga ekushisa avela ku-Open-Meteo, insita yamahhala legcina simo selitulu sayo yonkhe indzawo emhlabeni.
guide.stages.title: Tigaba letisitfupha
guide.stages.intro: Silimo ngasinye ensimini ngayinye sendlula kuletigaba ngalokulandzelana.
guide.stages.planning: Sikhatsi sekulima sesihleliwe, kodvwa silimo asikahlanyelwa.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Silimo sesibutse lokunyenti kwekushisa lesikudzingako, ngako sekuyisikhatsi sekulungiselela kuvuna.
guide.stages.harvested: Silimo sesibutse konkhe kushisa lesikudzingako, ngako kufanele kube sesivutfwe. Nguwe kuphela longasho kutsi sivuniwe mbamba, ngako i-app ibita loku ngekuvutfwa ngekushisa.
guide.stages.review: Sikhatsi sekulima sesiphelile, ungabuka kutsi sihambe njani.
guide.stages.p2: I-app ihlola silimo ngasinye busuku bonkhe nalapho umuntfu afaka lakubonile noma umsebenti lawentile. Ungaphindze ucindzetele Reconcile now kuleso sikhatsi sekulima kuze ihlole masinyane.
guide.start.title: Kucala
guide.start.1: Vula likhasi lasekhaya. Ungabona libalave lesimo selitulu, umhlabatsi, tilokatane nesivuno selipulazi lesibonelo ngaphandle kwekungena ngemvume.
guide.start.2: Cindzetela Sign in etulu, usebentise imininingwane ye-akhawunti yesibonelo loyinikwe yona.
guide.start.3: Khetsa lipulazi. Loku kuvula ideshibhodi yalelo pulazi.
guide.start.4: Cindzetela sikhatsi sekulima kuze ubone konkhe ngaleso silimo kuleyo nsimu.
guide.start.5: Sebentisa libhokisi lelimi etulu kunoma nguliphi likhasi kushintja lulwimi. I-app iyakukhumbula lokukhetsile nawuphindze ubuye.
guide.home.title: Likhasi lasekhaya
guide.home.p1: Likhasi lasekhaya likhombisa libalave lesifundza lelinemibala lekhombisa kutsi umhlaba utfole kushisa lokungakanani kulesikhatsi sekulima. Liphindze likhombise simo selitulu sanyalo nesemalanga lambalwa latako, umhlabatsi welipulazi lesibonelo, tilokatane letisandza kubonwa edvute nesivuno lesimaphakathi sesifundza. Awudzingi kungena ngemvume kuze ukubone.
guide.dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi yelipulazi
guide.dashboard.intro: Ideshibhodi ikhombisa lipulazi linye. Leti tincenye tayo kusukela etulu kuye phansi. Libhokisi lelipulazi lelisetulu likuvumela kutsi uye kulelinye lipulazi.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Sifinyeto selipulazi
guide.dashboard.summary: Linani lemasimu nemahektha elipulazi, tikhatsi tekulima letichubekako netilimo lesetivutfwe.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Lokudzinga kunakwa
guide.dashboard.alerts: Tecwayiso letimfisha, njengesitfwatfwa noma kushisa lokukhulu lokubiketelwe, silimo lesivutfwe, sikhatsi sekulima lesingakacali ngesikhatsi noma tilokatane letibonwe edvute nensimu. Secwayiso ngasinye sisho kutsi sibangelwe yini.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Simo selipulazi
guide.dashboard.conditions: Simo selitulu sanamuhla, sibikezelo, umhlabatsi netilokatane letisedvute nalelipulazi.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Kuchubeka kwesikhatsi sekulima
guide.dashboard.progress: Likhadi lesilimo ngasinye lelikhombisa kutsi sesibutse kushisa lokungakanani. Ungacatsanisa emasimu eceleni kwelinye, uphindze udawunilode luhla njengelifayela lesipredishithi (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Emasimu
guide.dashboard.fields: Onkhe emasimu elipulazi, nebukhulu bawo, umhlabatsi netilimo tawo.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Funa emarekhodi
guide.dashboard.search: Bhala lokufunako ngemavi lavamile, njenge-aphid kukolo. Itfola lokubonwe ensimini nemisebenti lenencazelo lefanako, ngisho noma kubhalwe ngemavi lahlukile.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Tincomo
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Umsebenti lophakanyisiwe wensimu, njengemutsi wekufafata noma manyolo. Ungavuma noma wale ngamunye, bese umaka kutsi wentiwe nawuphelile.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Lokwenteke muva
guide.dashboard.activity: Luhla lolukhombisa kutsi silimo ngasinye siye nini esigabeni lesisha.
guide.season.title: Likhasi lesikhatsi sekulima
guide.season.intro: Sikhatsi sekulima silimo sinye ensimini yinye ngemnyaka munye. Likhasi laso linako konkhe ngaso.
guide.season.top.label: Etulu kwelikhasi
guide.season.top: Silimo, insimu, lusuku lwekuhlanyela, lusuku lokulindzelwe kuvuna ngalo nesivuno nasewusifakile.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Kulandzelana kwetigaba
guide.season.pipeline: Tigaba letisitfupha, lesikhona nyalo simakiwe. Cindzetela Reconcile now kuze uhlole masinyane kutsi silimo kufanele yini sichubekele embili.
guide.season.readiness.label: Kulungele yini kuchubeka
guide.season.readiness: Luhla lwalokudzingwa yi-app ngaphambi kwekutsi ichubekisele silimo embili, njengelusuku lwekuhlanyela nemininingwane leyenele yesimo selitulu. Intfo ngayinye itsi Pass, Warning noma Blocked. Levinjiwe ikukhombisa lokushodako.
guide.season.evidence.label: Bufakazi
guide.season.evidence: Emarekhodi lasetjentiswe yi-app kwenta tincumo, kuze uwahlole.
guide.season.propose.label: Phakamisa sincomo
guide.season.propose: Phakamisa umsebenti walensimu, ufake nebufakazi balesikhatsi sekulima. Uhlala uluhlaka kuze kube khona lowuvumako kudeshibhodi.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Ishadi lelikhombisa emayunithi ekushisa ahlangana kusukela ekuhlanyelweni, linemugca welinani lelidzingwa silimo.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Kungentekani uma?
guide.season.whatIf: Linga lusuku lwekuhlanyela lolungaphambili noma lolusemuva, noma sikhatsi lesifutfumele noma lesibandzako, ubone kutsi emayunithi ekushisa angashintja njani. Kute lokugcinwako.
guide.season.summary.label: Sifinyeto sesikhatsi sekulima
guide.season.summary: Sifinyeto lesimfisha semarekhodi esikhatsi sekulima lesibhalwe yi-AI. Sisebentise njengemsiti, uhlole emarekhodi uma kukhona lokubonakala kungakalungi.
guide.season.notes.label: Emaphuzu esikhatsi sekulima
guide.season.notes: Emaphuzu esikhatsi sekulima lanetinsuku. Ungawengeta, uwashintje noma uwasuse, uphindze ubuyise luhlobo loludzala lweliphuzu.
guide.season.files.label: Sitfombe sensimu nembiko wekuhlolwa kwemhlabatsi
guide.season.files: Layisha sitfombe sensimu ne-PDF yekuhlolwa kwemhlabatsi levela elabhorethri.
guide.season.log.label: Ilogi yensimu
guide.season.log: Lokubonile ensimini nalokwente kuyo, njengemutsi lofafatiwe, ligama lawo nesilinganiso sawo.
guide.season.history.label: Umlandvo wetingucuko
guide.season.history: Lonke lushintjo lolugcinwe kulesikhatsi sekulima nelusuku lwalo.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Silinganiso sesifundza
guide.season.benchmark: Sivuno lesimaphakathi sesifundza lesivela etibalweni temphakatsi. Sekucatsanisa kuphela, akusiso sivuno sensimu yakho.
guide.season.pests.label: Tilokatane letibikwe esifundzeni
guide.season.pests: Tilokatane letibikwe ku-GBIF edvute nensimu, idathabhesi yemphakatsi yalokubonwe bantfu. Cindzetela Fetch sightings kuze utfole lokusha.
guide.sources.title: Tinombolo tivela kuphi
guide.sources.weather: Simo selitulu sivela ku-Open-Meteo, sanamuhla, sibikezelo nemalanga lendlulile.
guide.sources.soil: Umhlabatsi uvela ku-SoilGrids, libalave lemhlaba wonkhe lemininingwane yemhlabatsi.
guide.sources.pests: Lokubonwe kwetilokatane kuvela ku-GBIF, idathabhesi yemphakatsi yalokubonwe bantfu.
guide.sources.yields: Sivuno sesifundza sivela ku-USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa nase-World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Konkhe lokunye, njengemaphuzu, imisebenti nesivuno sakho, kufakwe nguwe noma licembu lakho.
guide.limits.title: Lokungeke ikwente
guide.limits.model: Emayunithi ekushisa ladzingwa silimo ngasinye atilinganiso tetfu, futsi awakahlolwa ensimini. Wasebentise njengemhlahlandlela, wetsembe loko lokubona ensimini yakho.
guide.limits.maturity: Kuvutfwa ngekushisa kusho kutsi simo selitulu sitsi silimo sesilungele kuvunwa. Nguwe kuphela lowatiko kutsi sesilungele mbamba yini.
guide.limits.translation: Letihumusho tibhalwe yi-AI. Kufanele kube melula kuticondza, kodvwa umuntfu lokhuluma lulwimi ngalokwemvelo akakahloli tonkhe tilwimi.
